body_markdown:
*By Valeriya Nerman*


Shopping for a software engineer, developer or tech lead can feel like solving a complex algorithm. But this year, the most thoughtful gift isn’t just another cool gadget — it is understanding that their entire job has fundamentally changed.


Developers today rarely write code from scratch. Instead, AI agents do the heavy lifting. But while this shift has brought incredible speed, it has also created an unexpected void: developers miss the creativity. They miss the fun stuff.


> *“We learn by doing. We love solving problems, building new things, working with others and pushing the limits.”*


I heard this from, I would say, 80% of the people who stopped for a chat at GitHub Universe this October. I don’t pretend this to be an exhaustive survey but the sentiment surely captures the true heart of software engineering. Developers are creators. But lately, their days are spent passively looking at screens, babysitting autonomous agents and waiting for code to generate. They have become supervisors rather than builders and they are craving a way to get their creative freedom back.


[Will Wang](http://youtube.com/@WillWang) , co-founder and CEO of AI creative studio Clova, notes that the secret to reclaiming that creativity lies in physical control. “When AI is doing all the typing, developers need a way to stay actively engaged in the architecture,” Will explains. “The right hardware transforms you from a passive observer back into an active director. It gives you the freedom to actually shape the build, rather than just waiting on it.”


This holiday season, the perfect gift is one that helps them reclaim their flow state and inject their own creativity back into the process.


Here is some inspiration: three products conceived to keep their hands on the controls and their head in the build.


#### Put them back in the director’s chair


When developers are just waiting on agents, they lose their momentum. To get their creative freedom back, they need a dedicated physical gateway to command their virtual teams and execute repetitive terminal commands.


[Logitech MX Keypad](https://www.logitech.com/shop/p/mx-keypad) puts a customizable LCD deck right beside their keyboard. Instead of clicking through tabs to approve AI actions, they can use tactile buttons to instantly direct agents, trigger local test environments, automate daily tasks, and steer the project. Every MX Keypad comes with a free three-month subscription to


[GitHub Copilot Pro+](https://github.com/features/copilot) , giving the coder in your life the ultimate physical control board to actively orchestrate their AI and daily workflows.


Did your developer already get their hands on the MX Keypad? Fear not, there is still plenty more upgrading possible.


#### Give them the power to sculpt massive codebases


Because AI agents generate thousands of lines of code in seconds, developers now spend their time acting as editors. Reading and auditing that much code can slow even the fastest engineer to a tedious, passive crawl.


The


[Logitech MX Master 4](https://www.logitech.com/shop/p/mx-master-4) is an iconic productivity mouse that pairs an amazing ergonomic shape with the exact speed they need. The MagSpeed scroll wheel zips through 1,000 lines of code per second, allowing them to quickly navigate and sculpt the AI’s output, hunting down logical errors and shaping the final product. With the customizable


[Actions Ring](https://www.logitech.com/software/actions-ring) , they can seamlessly jump between their active code editor, terminal and pull requests with a quick thumb movement, keeping their creative momentum alive.


#### Make the hands-on building feel amazing


When the AI has done the heavy lifting, there is always that final 10% – the custom logic, the unique architecture, the true creative problem-solving that only the developer can do. When they finally step in to write that code themselves, the experience should be flawless.


The Logitech


[MX Keys S](https://www.logitech.com/shop/p/mx-keys-s) delivers exactly that with a low-profile design and spherically-dished keys shaped for their fingertips. It keeps typing fast, fluid and comfortable, preventing hand fatigue so they can stay entirely focused on the build.


#### So what is the perfect gift for your developer


?


Still not sure which box belongs under the tree? Don’t try to guess. Just pay attention to what frustrates them most about their new workflow.


- If they complain about passively waiting on AI and want to feel like they are actively directing their tools again, wrap up the


MX Keypad.


- If they are overwhelmed by auditing massive walls of AI-generated code, go with the


MX Master 4.


- If they miss the tactile satisfaction of writing custom architecture, the premium comfort of the


MX Keys S


is your winner.


Want to go all in? Pairing all three creates the ultimate desk setup to reclaim the build. Good luck with holiday shopping!


*About the author: Valeriya is a marketing and portfolio strategist with nearly a decade in hardware-software innovation. She translates how modern builders and advanced users actually work into category-defining products, creators ecosystems, and breakout narratives.*
